F1: website_name` is missing from `untrusted_attributes`, and its `include_website_name` method has no `?`, so nothing guards it; anonymous viewers get the hostname (and sometimes the path) of a TL0 user's website even though `website` itself is hidden from them.
F2: User#save` only copies `bio_excerpt` from the PUT response and the preferences route reuses the parent user model, so the profile shows a stale `website_name` (or none at all) after the website is changed, until the page is reloaded.
